prompt.default: You work for a home care team. Plan this week's tasks for Anna (nurse) and Bas (care assistant). Read the notes on the cards: they tell you the rules. Nobody works more than 8 hours a day, and after 4 hours of work there is a break of at least 30 minutes.
prompt.$comment: in a rota mode the default is replaced by the rota example's instruction

planner.$comment: JSON written by the authoring mode (planner.ts): days, times, opening hours, resources, fixed blocks, tasks, the example solution and the checks; empty: the example

label.en: Staff rota: shop, employees, shifts, rules, questions and pay
label.nl: Dienstrooster: winkel, medewerkers, diensten, regels, vragen en loon

rota.$comment: JSON written by the authoring mode (rota.ts) for the modes readRota, makeRota and hoursAndPay; empty: the example (a corner shop)

label.en: Show conflicts while planning (overlaps, outside opening hours; in a rota: the rules)
label.nl: Botsingen tonen tijdens het plannen (overlap, buiten openingstijden; in een rooster: de regels)
